name: Speak with Dillinger
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
I was told Deathguard Dillinger has a job for someone like you.  If you're willing to show your value to the Dark Lady's forces, then report to Dillinger immediately.

Deathguard Dillinger's post is on the west end of Brill, near the graveyard.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
narrative.offerRewardText: You're here for a mission? Good. I have an important one, and one that will test your skill in combat... and your resolve in the defense of the Forsaken.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 10 to 11, 2,670 XP in all.

quests.name: Speak with Dillinger
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

quests.name: Ulag the Cleaver
quests.objectiveText: Kill Ulag the Cleaver, then speak with Deathguard Dillinger.

quests.name: Agamand Heirlooms
quests.objectiveText: Bring Coleman Farthing the Agamand Family Axe, the Agamand Family Sword, the Agamand Family Mace and the Agamand Family dagger.
